info.name: SpendOptix AI Planner
info.description:
Two-step AI planner (suggest -> generate) plus plan persistence (create/save/list/get/approve). Set {{baseUrl}} and {{authToken}} in the collection/environment variables — every route except health checks requires a Bearer token: a real Firebase ID token (project: justbaat-apps), or the static test token already filled in below (doesn't expire).

Typical flow: 1) Suggestions (prompt -> pre-filled form) -> 2) have the user review/edit the "input" it returns -> 3) Generate a plan (plans -> POST) from that input -> 4) Create (plan -> POST) to save it with a server-generated id, or Update if you already have one.

item.name: Suggest form fields from a prompt

request.description:
Free text in, a fully pre-filled form out (every field, never blank) plus a provenance tag per field: "stated" (literally in the prompt), "inferred" (worked out from context), or "assumed" (no signal at all, a plausible default). The response's "data.input" is exactly what you'd send to Generate below, after the user reviews/edits it.

Junk is rejected with 422 and a reason: text too short or mostly symbols (checked in code, no LLM call), or text the model judges is not an advertising brief (e.g. a poem, a general question). "warnings" lists values extracted from the brief that cannot be right (invalid or past dates, end before start, a KPI target over 100%, a non-Indian state, an IAB category not in the data, an unrealistic budget/CPM/frequency cap). They are removed from "input" so the planner can fill them in.

Every field is optional (sensible defaults apply) — this is the full PlannerInput shape with everything filled in as an example. Nothing is persisted by this call; it returns a GeneratedPlan (header, keyFigures, flight, pricing, bestDates, budgetCurve, cpmCurve, benefitSummary, budgetAllocation, plannedByTeam, audience, buying, brandSafety, checks). "pricing" lists the targeting uplifts already baked into every CPM, each a % of the base price, added not compounded: 1-4 states +10%; any demographic (age, gender, income) +10%; interest (iabCategories) + demographic together +15% instead. "bestDates.source" is "viewership-calendar" when the flight falls inside the loaded viewership calendar (scripts/ingest-calendar.js): windows are then picked and scored in code from each day's CTV/App/Web multiplier weighted by the plan's channel mix (score = share of possible windows beaten; each window also carries viewershipMultiplier and events). Otherwise it is "ai-estimate" and the AI judges the dates (viewershipMultiplier null). Each recommended item's avails/uniqueAudience are targetable figures, R = N × p1 × p2^0.5 × p3^0.25, where the p's are the item's shares in the selected age / gender / income bands sorted largest first (targetingFactor = R/N; 1 when nothing is targeted or the item has no demographic data). Save it afterward with "Create a plan" below if you want to keep it.

"rawPrompt" carries the original free-text brief through from Suggestions (or set it directly if calling Generate without Suggestions first) — it's informational only, never parsed again here.

Allowed enum values:
- campaign.objective: awareness, reach, consideration, video-views, traffic, app-installs, leads, sales
- campaign.kpis[].metric: vcr, ctr (only these two)
- campaign.pacing: even, front-loaded, back-loaded, burst
- audience.geoScope: pan-india, states (no "cities" anymore — states + optional excludeStates only)
- audience.gender: all, male, female
- audience.ageGroups: 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+
- audience.incomeGroups: premium, upper-middle, middle, lower-middle, value (monthly household income ₹1,00,000+ / ₹60,000-99,999 / ₹30,000-59,999 / ₹15,000-29,999 / under ₹15,000)
- inventory.platforms: ctv, ctv-oem, ctv-fast, ctv-ott, mobile-ott, web, mweb, in-app, youtube
- inventory.mediaTypes: display, video
- inventory.qualityTier: premium-only, premium-preferred, any
- inventory.iabCategories: must match one of the real categories in the ingested data (fetched live from the server — ask backend for the current list, e.g. "Beauty & Fitness", "Finance", "News", "Shopping", ...)
- inventory.channelCpmTargets: [{platform, maxCpm}] — per-channel rate asks, e.g. different CPMs for ctv-fast vs ctv-ott
- creative.videoPlacements: instream, outstream, interstitial
- creative.videoDurations: under-10s, under-30s, up-to-60s
- creative.skippability: skippable, non-skippable
- buying.dspChoice: spendoptix-dsp, own-dsp
- buying.spendoptixDspRoute: dv360, authorised-buyer
- buying.dealType: pmp, programmatic-guaranteed, preferred-deal, open-auction, any
- buying.frequencyCap.period: day, week, month, campaign
- plannerSettings.optimiseFor: reach, cost-efficiency, quality, viewability, balanced
- plannerSettings.diversification: concentrated, balanced, broad

Note: brand.url, brand.competitors, audience.cities/affluenceSec/incomeBand (replaced by incomeGroups)/interests/behaviours/lifeStage/languages/audienceNotes, inventory.contentGenres/mustInclude/categoriesToAvoid/brandSafetyExclusions, and creative.videoPositions have all been removed from the form.

Invalid values (same checks as the Suggestions warnings) are rejected with 422, listing every problem.

Regenerates a plan after the planner edits it.

- input: the full current form (same shape as Generate), with any manual field edits already applied.
- prompt: send ONLY if the prompt text was edited. Omitted/null/same as input.rawPrompt -> the earlier prompt stays unchanged and no extra AI call is made. When sent and different, an AI call updates only the form fields the prompt edit affects (manual edits are kept), and input.rawPrompt becomes the new prompt. It can be a rewritten brief or a short instruction like "drop YouTube" / "remove JioHotstar".
- previousPlan: the plan being refined (Generate's data, or the previous Refine's data.plan).

Returns { input, promptChanged, promptChanges[{field,from,to}], plan, diff{keyFigures, linesAdded, linesRemoved, lineChanges} }. For another round, send back data.input and data.plan as input/previousPlan. Nothing is persisted - save with Create/Update.

An edited prompt gets the same checks as Suggestions: 422 for junk or an edit unrelated to the plan, and "warnings" for invalid values the edit produced (removed from input).

item.name: Get a saved plan by id
Create a plan (server generates the id)

request.description: Body is {"input", "plan"} — the exact two objects from Suggestions' "data.input" (as sent to Generate) and Generate's "data" response, unmodified. The server mints a UUID and returns it as "id" (201 Created) — paste that into the {{planId}} collection variable to use the requests below it. This is the only place a new saved record gets created; nothing here trusts a caller-supplied id.
Same body shape as Create, but for a planId you already have (e.g. re-saving after the user edits something). Upsert — creates it if that id doesn't exist yet, replaces it if it does.
